scenarios.title: Star Health Comprehensive Insurance Policy
scenarios.document_text: POLICY NUMBER: P/123456/01/2026/001234. Insured: Alice Sharma. Sum Insured: Rs. 10,00,000. Room Rent Limit: No capping for normal rooms, ICU actual charges. Pre-existing disease waiting period: 36 months from policy commencement date. Cataract limit: Rs. 40,000 per eye. Maternity coverage available after 24 months waiting period up to Rs. 50,000 for normal delivery and Rs. 75,000 for caesarean section. Cumulative bonus: 50% increase in sum insured for every claim-free year up to maximum 100%.
